introHtml: Enamel lanyards and badges offer a durable, high-gloss finish that resists scratching and fading, making them ideal for daily wear in corporate settings or events. The smooth enamel surface allows for crisp logo reproduction with vibrant colors, ensuring your brand stands out. Whether you need ID badges for employees or branded lanyards for a trade show, enamel provides a polished look that lasts. Choose from metal or plastic base materials with custom shapes and sizes to match your needs.
